Well, originally I was thinking this could be fixed. Like the top comment, check for leaks, mold damage, etc., and repair that before you do anything else. You will have to replace the flooring or refinish it.

When there is water damage in hardwood floors, you can put a little hydrogen peroxide on the water damage and let it sit to sort of bleach and dry out the wood. The seal is probably gone, so even if you do this and the stain is gone or not as noticeable, you'll have to put a new seal on that area at least. You can usually refinish hardwoods several times over the lifetime of the flooring, but if this is older flooring (50+ years) you may have to replace it. Every time hardwoods are refinished you have to sand them down, and the planks can only get so thin before you just have to replace them.

Anyway, if subflooring is ok, you might be able to keep the floor. You can use the same trick on the bookcase with the hydrogen peroxide, sand it and refinish it. Google the hydrogen peroxide on hardwoods, because I can't remember the procedure. I think you put it on some paper towels or a towel and let it sit on the floor for a few hours. But check and repair whatever is causing the leak first.

Oh. Well, if it's not a leak you should be able to do the hydrogen peroxide thing. I had a puppy do the same near my back door and it worked. The finish is nearly gone, and I'm waiting to do all the floors, so I'm just careful to not let spills or water sit there. If you don't seal it, be careful mopping, as the wood will just absorb whatever gets on the floor.

A cheap temporary option may be rejuvenate or something similar at a hardware store. I think it would cost $50 for the materials, but I can't remember if you can use it where the deal is gone. Its a temporary poly seal to help worn floors look like new. Since its a small spot, you can use it (if the seal is there a little bit) every 6-12 months until you can afford a permanent solution. The $50 I spent did about 1000 square feet and filled in light scratches from puppy nails.

Usually pet urine can get through the seal but not totally destroy it, so it may still be there. If the surface doesn't feel very smooth compared to non damaged floor, the seal is probably gone.

Fould smelling warm air was inching closer. The King couldn't hide from these things. They always seemed to know where he was.

He jumped from hiding, a loud SCREEECH bullowing from behind. Now the heavy thumping of the pack of [wraiths](http://i.imgur.com/JlyfZau.jpg) chasing him continued. The chase had been going on for a few continents, using his powers as a Demigod to outrun then. Her hatred for him was what spawned these unrelenting monsters.

He needed to shake them. He needed to find her. He slipped inside an [Air Exchange Shoot](http://i.imgur.com/wCf2Be9.jpg). It was made of biomass. Made by her. He caressed the shoot appreciating what a nice goddess she was. Wraiths started pounding the structure. This wouldn't hold up past the third hit. The Air Exchange Biome was a network of underground shafts and tunnels filled with porous aerated material. Tendrils from these shaft went into the ground to diffuse air. Making the soil of Solus prosper.

The king dug his way into the foamy core material. He was hugged on all sides and pushed through. The system carried the stench of the wraiths. It was as if they were still close. He knew this wasn't the case. He had been chased for days. As long as he didn't hear screeching or thumping he was relatively safe.

At another shute he exited. He had built up a lead. A citadel was moving abovehead. He signaled the porter. A rope ladder got thrown from the outer rim. He climbed it and got pulled up. A dustcloud on the horizon being evidence of the wraith's approach.

He bribed his way past the porter and bargained for some clothes with stature. Then he went to the outpost to look at the approaching doom. It wasn't long now.

Horns sounded. Had they noticed too? No. It was something else. A ton of humans dressed in red strode out of the most fortified building. Their speaker commanded the crowd be silent to make way for the King. One ofhis brothers had escaped as well? With full attention he awaited the reveal. How disappointing. It was just [a fat human](http://i.dailymail.co.uk/i/pix/2013/12/28/article-0-1A48454600000578-792_306x592.jpg). What was he king of anyway?

The thumping was becoming noticeable. His reprieve had been short lived. Would the citadel, easily 10 times as tall as a wraith hold it up?

The floor beneath them dropped. A loud thump. A screech. Waves of blood and guts. A wraith had made it to the outer rim. The citadel seemed to to have hidden itself from the attacks of the Wraiths. Leaving the city low to the ground and vulnerable.

With haste the King of diamonds took his leave. He had run far away, and the wraiths hadn't followed. The king. She made then hunt everything bearing my name. She must have hated him so through and through. It did however give the king a plan. He conjured [a brandishing iron](http://willkrause.com/wp-content/gallery/branding_iron_and-_embers/branding_embers_4.jpg) with the word KING and started branding some of the mega fauna. Unconvinced this would suffice he trekked to cities of Humans and [Blix](http://images.cryhavok.org/d/13760-1/Imp+by+Beloved+Creature.jpg).

He started showering a single person of each community with wealth and made this great speech for the public eye about how the rich mortal would be their king. A lot of flair and grandure was involved. He pretended to be a real god and claimed this was a mandate from the gods. It was desperate. Would it help? These poor communities sure wouldn't survive.

As long as it gave him time.

With that, about a month after he had broken his promise to Saol he could finally start his search. [She](http://i.imgur.com/AKiHTtk.jpg) would love him again when their eyes met. With that sprinkle of hope. Occasionally brandishing a mega fauna with the word KING he started calling out her name in every forest.
Driven by desire, The King of Diamonds runs around like a madman looking for Saol. Unfortunately for him, Saol wants to see him suffer.
